M1.reason: Measured overlap clears 0.80 in every view (0.886 front/back, 0.962 left/right, 0.888 top/below), but the outline is clearly off in the top and below views. The original's grip rakes back and tapers, with a flared beavertail where it meets the slide. The reproduction's grip is a square-cornered rectangular block set straight, with no rake and no beavertail. The same boxy grip shows in the front-left, front-right and back-left angles and in in-hand.png.

M2.reason: Length 14.7 against 14.8, width 9.6 against 9.5 and height 3.0 against 2.8. The largest difference is 5.7%, inside 10% on every axis.

M3.reason: The slide, frame, trigger guard, trigger, grip and muzzle bore are all there, one of each, in the right places. The grip has the wrong shape, though: a rectangular box where the original has a raked, tapered grip with a beavertail (top, below and angle views). The trigger is a thin bright bar unlike the original's. The step between frame and slide that the original has on its right side is also missing.

M4.reason: The smoothed mean ΔE is 5.1, and no view exceeds 6.9, well under 15. On the w_ model each region is the original's grey gunmetal, with a darker grip. This is measured on w_ only. The v_ model's colour difference is counted under M6.

M5.reason: The muzzle bore and a dark band near the slide's step are there. Most of the original's detail is missing or blurred: the long recessed groove down both sides of the slide (left and right views), the rear slide serrations (top and below views), the front-strap ridges, and the stippled grip panel with its edge trim. The reproduction's texture is low-resolution blocky noise, much less sharp than the original's.

M6.reason: In first-person.png and first-person-attack.png the original pistol is dark blue-black with crisp slide detail. The reproduction is a light silver-grey and blurry, so a player would see at once that it is a different gun skin, even though it has the same pose and roughly the same shape. On the world and in-hand models the boxy grip and coarse texture also show at a glance.

M7.reason: In every view the muzzle points the same way as the original's and the grip hangs on the same side. It is upright, and it sits on the origin at the same place in every view.

M8.reason: There are no check errors. It has 96 triangles against the original's 88, well under twice. Nothing in the pictures looks open, inside out or floating.

W1.reason: In first-person.png the pistol sits in the same place in the same hand, held the same way and the same way round. In every attack frame (2 to 14) it follows the original's recoil and recovery, and it stays in the hand throughout.
